moa: CDK2 inhibition removes the CCNE1/CDK2-driven proliferative dependency and impairs CDK2-mediated collapsed-fork HR repair in CCNE1-amplified HGSOC.
rationale: CCNE1-amplified HGSOC is HR-proficient and platinum-resistant; CDK2 inhibition (BLU-222, dinaciclib) is selectively active in this context.

moa: WEE1 inhibition abrogates the G2/M checkpoint, forcing replication-stressed CCNE1-high cells into premature mitosis and mitotic catastrophe.
rationale: Cyclin E1 overexpression sensitizes HGSOC to WEE1 inhibition; CCNE1 copy number is a biomarker for WEE1-ATR response.

moa: ATR inhibition removes the replication-stress checkpoint that a replication-stress-tolerant, HR-proficient genome relies on, causing fork collapse and double-strand breaks.
rationale: ATR inhibition (+/- PARP) overcomes platinum/PARP resistance in HR-proficient and CCNE1-amplified HGSOC models.

moa: CHK1 inhibition disables the intra-S/G2 checkpoint, converting endogenous replication stress in CCNE1-high tumors into lethal DNA damage.
rationale: CHK1 inhibitor SRA737 is active in PARPi-resistant and CCNE1-amplified HGSOC.

moa: PKMYT1 inhibition drives CCNE1-amplified cells into premature, catastrophic mitosis (synthetic lethal with CCNE1 amplification).
rationale: CCNE1 amplification is synthetic lethal with PKMYT1 inhibition (Nature 2022).
